subject: The alert form wipes what the user typed whenever the alerts page re-renders, because useConfigs returns a freshly filtered array each render
activeForm: Stopping the alert form from resetting on parent re-renders

work_items: Stop AlertForm resetting user input when its parent re-renders

description: Found by card #17 on 2026-10-14 while moving AlertForm's reset out of an effect. The form re-initializes its fields whenever its configurations prop changes identity (frontend/src/components/dashboard/alert-form.tsx, the formInputs comparison; before card #17 the same dependency sat in a useEffect). useConfigs returns configurations as configurations.filter(...) (frontend/src/hooks/use-configs.ts:130-136), a new array on every render of the alerts page. So any re-render of the alerts page while the form is open, such as a react-query refetch on window focus, resets the form to its initial values and drops what the user entered. Card #17 preserved the behaviour deliberately rather than change it inside a lint fix. Unmeasured in a browser. Likely fix: compare configurations by content (or by the ids it offers), or memoise visibleConfigurations in useConfigs; add a test that re-renders AlertForm with an equal but new configurations array and expects user input kept.
